history.content: How often does MV Kestrel go into dry dock?

MV Kestrel, Tidewater's vehicle ferry, is dry-docked every 30 months [1]. Dry-docking is planned for the quiet months between November and February, and never for two route vessels in the same winter, so the timetable can keep running with one route vessel and the relief vessel [1]. Vessels under 45 metres go to Pellin Slipway and longer ones to the Dunmere graving dock, and a period normally takes nine to fourteen days including the passage to the yard [1]. At every second visit the Kestrel's bow thruster tunnel is shot-blasted and recoated, which adds about four days [1]. Before it returns to service, the chief engineer signs it off after a sea trial with full astern and a crash-stop test [1]. Between dry-docks, a diver inspects its hull, propellers and rudders every 6 months [2].
